items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 114:1
items.html: Because it has in it the coarseness of phase four, so that the level of its reflected light ascends and clothes as far as the Keter of direct light. (Chapter 9, Item 6 and Item 8)
